name: ADK Ambient Expense Agent
description: Event-driven ADK agent that processes expense reports from Pub/Sub, auto-approving small ones and routing large ones to a manager.
whatItDoes: Expense events arrive in the background; amounts under a threshold are approved immediately, while larger ones get an LLM risk review and wait for a manager's decision in an approval UI. It demonstrates ambient (non-chat) agents for finance operations teams.
howItWorks: An ADK graph workflow mixes plain function nodes for business rules with LLM nodes for judgement, pausing for human input on high-value items. Locally it runs a backend and an approval frontend; Terraform deploys two Cloud Run services with Pub/Sub and monitoring alerts.

requirements.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
requirements.description: AI Studio key in .env; Vertex AI variables are the alternative

requirements.name: make
requirements.description: Recipe is driven by Makefile targets
